state.seed_assertion: A DPIA is NOT required where processing was previously found not to be at risk by DPIA.

sentences.1: A DPIA is NOT required where processing was previously found not to be at risk by DPIA.
sentences.2: A DPIA is NOT required where: Processing operations do not result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of individuals;
sentences.3: Processing was previously found not to be at risk by DPIA;
sentences.4: The fact that the DPIA may need to be updated once the processing has actually started is not a valid reason for postponing or not carrying out a DPIA.
sentences.5: The fact that the DPIA may need to be updated once the processing has actually started is not a valid reason for postponing or not carrying out a DPIA.
sentences.6: You need to be confident that you can demonstrate that the nature, scope, context and purposes of the processing are all similar when relying on a previously completed substantially similar DPIA.
sentences.7: You need to be confident that you can demonstrate that the nature, scope, context and purposes of the processing are all similar.
sentences.8: The mere fact that the conditions triggering the obligation to carry out DPIA have not been met does not diminish controllers' general obligation to implement measures to appropriately manage risks for the rights and freedoms of data subjects.
